correctness.rationale: Each quotient \(G/N_i\) realizes \(\theta_i\) because outgoing parameters lie in \(N_i\) and incoming parameters do not. Once \(a_{ij}=e\), every further homomorphism preserves that equality, while \(\theta_j\) requires \(a_{ij}\ne e\). This directly proves pairwise future-incompatibility and falsifies the displayed \(\mathsf{S4.3}\) axiom. The finite-abelian and elementary-abelian corollaries use standard subgroup facts only.

value.rationale: The result gives a structural bridge from the width of the normal-subgroup lattice to homomorphic modal branching. It addresses finite torsion groups outside the recent source's uniformly prime-indivisible exact-\(\mathsf{S4.2}\) theorem, yields a broad finite-abelian consequence, and gives the explicit branch count \((p^n-1)/(p-1)\) for \((C_p)^n\).
